items.title: Rajasthan Royals and Lucknow Super Giants reported to be exploring a multi-player trade
items.summary: Reports link Mohammed Shami and Sam Curran to the talks. No deal has been announced by either franchise.

items.title: Cameron Green and Trent Boult named among players whose futures are uncertain
items.summary: Sportstar's outlook on possible releases before the retention deadline. These are the writers' views, not franchise decisions.

items.title: Hardik Pandya moves to Punjab Kings, Arshdeep Singh to Mumbai Indians
items.summary: The IPL confirmed the straight swap, the fourth completed trade of the cycle. Ten players have now changed teams.

items.title: Key dates and rules: registration, final auction register and squad limits
items.summary: Player registration closes on 23 November and the final auction register is due on 3 December. Squads can hold 25 players, up to 8 overseas, under a 157 crore salary cap.

items.title: CSK and SRH complete a four-player trade
items.summary: Liam Livingstone and Jack Edwards join Chennai Super Kings. Khaleel Ahmed and Nathan Ellis join Sunrisers Hyderabad.

items.title: Retention deadline moved to 17 November; mini-auction on 16 December in Goa
items.summary: Franchises now have until 17 November to submit retained and released lists. The auction date and venue are unchanged.
